HOUSING AUTHORITY MINUTES - 06/03/15 - 7PM
HOUSING AUTHORITY MINUTES - 06/03/15 - 7PM
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
JUNE 03, 2015
06:30 P.M.
AGENDA NO. 112
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
For record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER.
2. ROLL CALL: CHAIR LEDFORD, VICE CHAIR DISPENZA, COMMISSIONERS HOFBAUER, THOMPSON, MARTINEZ, BROWN, AND SANCHEZ
3. WAIVER OF FULL READING OF RESOLUTION(S).
Staff Recommendation: Move to waive full reading of the Resolution(s) to be considered and voted on at this meeting. (Voice Vote - Requires a majority to waive.)
4. CONSENT CALENDAR - PUBLIC COMMENTS ONLY:
5. CONSENT CALENDAR:
5.1 Consideration of 1) Resolution HA 2015-002 Authorizing a) the Financing of the Acquisition and Rehabilitation of Affordable Housing Units APN's 3009-021-035, 3014-001-002, 3014-026-019, 3014-028-001; b) Documents and Agreements related to the Acquisition and Bond Financing: the A-5108 Property Transfer Agreement and Joint Escrow Instruction with National Community Renaissance, the Preliminary Official Statement, A-5109 Bond Purchase Agreement, A-5107 Indenture of Trust and Deeds of Trust, A-5111 with Quint and Thimmig, LLP, A-5145 for Harrell and Associates, A-5144 LDM Associates; 2) A-4974 Agreement for Management of the Properties after acquisition with Newport Pacific Capital Company, Inc.; 3) Addition of one staff position related to ongoing asset management. (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
5.1a ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. HA 2015-002, A RESOLUTION OF THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE AUTHORIZING THE ISSUANCE OF MULTIFAMILY HOUSING REVENUE BONDS, SERIES 2015 (IMPRESSIONS, LA QUINTA, PARK VISTA AND SUMMERWOOD APARTMENTS), APPROVING AND AUTHORIZING EXECUTION OF A PROPERTY TRANSFER AGREEMENT, AN INDENTURE OF TRUST, DEEDS OF TRUST, A BOND PURCHASE AGREEMENT, AN OFFICIAL STATEMENT, A CONTINUING DISCLOSURE CERTIFICATE AND RELATED DOCUMENTS, AND AUTHORIZING ACTIONS RELATED THERETO.
HA 5.1
HA 5.1 ATTACHMENT
5.2 1) Approve the Housing Authority's grant of the proposed additional security interest in its underlying fee title, for the purpose of converting construction financing on the Wright Brothers Court Apartments to permanent loans; 2) Authorize staff to modify the terms of the Third Amendment to Agreement A-3079 with Palmdale TOD Apartments, L.P. for that purpose; and 3) Authorize the Executive Director or his designee to execute all necessary documents and take all necessary actions. (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
Staff Recommendation: Move to approve the recommendations and findings on all items listed under the Consent Calendar. (Voice Vote - Requires a majority to approve.)
HA 5.2
6. NON-AGENDA ITEMS - PUBLIC COMMENTS:
7. ADJOURNMENT.

1.
CALL TO ORDER.
Chair Ledford called the meeting to order at 7:30 p.m.
2.
ROLL CALL: CHAIR LEDFORD, VICE CHAIR DISPENZA, COMMISSIONERS HOFBAUER, THOMPSON, MARTINEZ, BROWN, AND SANCHEZ
PRESENT:
Chair Ledford, Vice Chair Dispenza, Commissioner Hofbauer, Commissioner Thompson, Commissioner Martinez, Commissioner Brown, Commissioner Sanchez.
ABSENT:
None.
3.
WAIVER OF FULL READING OF RESOLUTION(S).
Motion: Move to waive full reading of the Resolution(s) to be considered and voted on at this meeting.
Moved by Commissioner Hofbauer,
seconded by Vice Chair Dispenza.
Vote: Motion carried (7-0)
Yes: Chair Ledford, Vice Chair Dispenza, Commissioner Hofbauer, Commissioner Thompson, Commissioner Martinez, Commissioner Brown, Commissioner Sanchez.
4.
CONSENT CALENDAR - PUBLIC COMMENTS ONLY:
Motion: Pull Item No. 5.1.
Moved by Commissioner Hofbauer,
seconded by Commissioner Martinez.
Vote: Motion carried (7-0)
Yes: Chair Ledford, Vice Chair Dispenza, Commissioner Hofbauer, Commissioner Thompson, Commissioner Martinez, Commissioner Brown, Commissioner Sanchez.
5.
CONSENT CALENDAR:
5.1
Consideration of 1) Resolution HA 2015-002 Authorizing a) the Financing of the Acquisition and Rehabilitation of Affordable Housing Units APN's 3009-021-035, 3014-001-002, 3014-026-019, 3014-028-001; b) Documents and Agreements related to the Acquisition and Bond Financing: the A-5108 Property Transfer Agreement and Joint Escrow Instruction with National Community Renaissance, the Preliminary Official Statement, A-5109 Bond Purchase Agreement, A-5107 Indenture of Trust and Deeds of Trust, A-5111 with Quint and Thimmig, LLP, A-5145 for Harrell and Associates, A-5144 LDM Associates; 2) A-4974 Agreement for Management of the Properties after acquisition with Newport Pacific Capital Company, Inc.; 3) Addition of one staff position related to ongoing asset management. (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
Housing Coordinator Reyes presented the staff report and read the title of Resolution No. HA 2015-002.
5.1a
ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. HA 2015-002, A RESOLUTION OF THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE AUTHORIZING THE ISSUANCE OF MULTIFAMILY HOUSING REVENUE BONDS, SERIES 2015 (IMPRESSIONS, LA QUINTA, PARK VISTA AND SUMMERWOOD APARTMENTS), APPROVING AND AUTHORIZING EXECUTION OF A PROPERTY TRANSFER AGREEMENT, AN INDENTURE OF TRUST, DEEDS OF TRUST, A BOND PURCHASE AGREEMENT, AN OFFICIAL STATEMENT, A CONTINUING DISCLOSURE CERTIFICATE AND RELATED DOCUMENTS, AND AUTHORIZING ACTIONS RELATED THERETO.
Public Comments: None.
Council asked questions and staff responded.
Motion: Adopt Resolution No. HA 2015-002.
Moved by Commissioner Hofbauer,
seconded by Vice Chair Dispenza.
Vote: Motion carried (7-0)
Yes: Chair Ledford, Vice Chair Dispenza, Commissioner Hofbauer, Commissioner Thompson, Commissioner Martinez, Commissioner Brown, Commissioner Sanchez.
5.2
1) Approve the Housing Authority's grant of the proposed additional security interest in its underlying fee title, for the purpose of converting construction financing on the Wright Brothers Court Apartments to permanent loans; 2) Authorize staff to modify the terms of the Third Amendment to Agreement A-3079 with Palmdale TOD Apartments, L.P. for that purpose; and 3) Authorize the Executive Director or his designee to execute all necessary documents and take all necessary actions. (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
Motion: Move to approve the recommendations and findings on all items listed under the Consent Calendar, with the exception of Item No. 5.1.
Moved by Commissioner Hofbauer,
seconded by Commissioner Martinez.
Vote: Motion carried (7-0)
Yes: Chair Ledford, Vice Chair Dispenza, Commissioner Hofbauer, Commissioner Thompson, Commissioner Martinez, Commissioner Brown, Commissioner Sanchez.
Chair Ledford recessed the HA meeting at this time.
6.
NON-AGENDA ITEMS - PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Heard jointly with the CC and SA meetings.
For further details, please see the City Council minutes for June 3, 2015 7 p.m.
7.
ADJOURNMENT.
Chair Ledford adjourned the meeting at 9:50 p.m.
PASSED, APPROVED, and ADOPTED this 5th day of August 2015.
